The spaced repetition page serves to display lessons that are ready to be 
revised. Much of the functionality of these pages matches that of the lesson 
selection activity. Since there is a high probability that these pages maybe 
empty, an illustration was generated, to show a study hut (the name of the 
product) to help fill the space and serve as a subtle reward for the student 
completing their revision. Lessons that have been ready for longer will be 
displayed at the top of the page, ensuring that no lessons get lost at the bottom 
of the queue and therefore never revised. To generate the image on Figure 19, 
(OpenAI, n.d.)’s Dalle3 was used to generate a simple hut by a fire, offering a 
simple reward for students that have completed all their lessons.
